name: HSBC Holdings plc
note: Publicly listed in London (HSBA), Hong Kong (0005) and New York (HSBC ADRs); principal holding company of the HSBC group per hsbc.com/investors (group structure). The major holdings notified to HSBC Holdings in 2025, per its Annual Report and Accounts 2025 ('Notifiable interests in share capital'), are asset managers and a depositary: BlackRock 9.09%, Ping An Asset Management 7.98%, BNY Mellon 6.01% — no state body among them.
